title: 1984 string theory takeover, 'the only game in town'
summary: Eric Weinstein tells of 1984 string theory takeover, 'the only game in town', about 1984 at theoretical physics community, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And then right up until 1984 where we get the green schwarz anomaly cancellation and Ed Whitten, Lewis Whitten's son directs the entire field uh to put its energies on one bet.

plain: A mathematician and podcaster, Eric Weinstein, says that in 1984, after a mathematical breakthrough called the Green-Schwarz anomaly cancellation, the leading physicist Ed Witten steered the whole field of theoretical physics to bet everything on one idea, string theory. Weinstein tells it to argue that physics narrowed itself to a single path and stalled, which matters if new physics is the key to understanding unexplained craft.
